faqs.question: What does Pan Neurotropic Profile PCR - CSF measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence of 3 RNA, 3 DNA, 3 Mycobacterium spp and 1 parasite of Pan Herpes DNA, Pan Flavivirus RNA, Pan Enterovirus RNA and Pan Paramyxovirus RNA viruses in cerebral spinal fluid.

faqs.question: Why is Pan Neurotropic Profile PCR - CSF done?
faqs.answer: • To detect Pan Herpes DNA, Pan Flavivirus RNA, Pan Enterovirus RNA and Pan Paramyxovirus RNA viruses in the neurological system • To determine the appropriate treatment • To monitor treatment progress

faqs.question: When is Pan Neurotropic Profile recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended for patients • who show symptoms of neurological diseases that include severe headaches, stiff neck, fever, seizures, or confusion, or • display suspected viral meningitis, encephalitis, or paralysis.

faqs.question: What if the results of the Pan Neurotropic Profile are abnormal?
faqs.answer: If an abnormal result is found, it may indicate that a neurotropic virus is present in the central nervous system that can cause encephalitis, meningitis, or other neurological diseases.

faqs.question: What to expect during the Pan Neurotropic Profile?
faqs.answer: • A small amount of cerebrospinal fluid will be collected from your lower back using a needle. • The sample will be sent to a laboratory for analysis.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the Pan Neurotropic Profile?
faqs.answer: • Tell your doctor if you have any bleeding disorders or are taking blood-thinning medication. • Drink plenty of fluids on the day of the test. • Avoid eating or drinking anything for six hours before the test. • Discuss any medication with your physician that you may need to stop taking a few days before the test. • Inform your doctor if you have any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with Pan Neurotropic Profile?
faqs.answer: • Blood tests to look for antibodies against specific viruses • Lumbar puncture to detect other conditions that could cause similar symptoms

faqs.question: What is the Pan Neurotropic Profile PCR - CSF also known as?
faqs.answer: Pan Viral PCR, Meningitis/Encephalitis panel, or Pan Pathogen Panel

faqs.question: What are meningitis and encephalitis?
faqs.answer: Meningitis is a condition that causes inflammation in the protective tissue surrounding the brain and spinal cord. Encephalitis is a condition that causes inflammation in the brain tissue itself. Both conditions are caused by viruses, and symptoms can range from mild to severe.
